signature: SUBROUTINE ZGGES( JOBVSL, JOBVSR, SORT, SELCTG, N, A, LDA, B, LDB,

params.name: jobvsl
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: do not compute the left Schur vectors;
-   `= 'V'`: compute the left Schur vectors.

params.name: jobvsr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: do not compute the right Schur vectors;
-   `= 'V'`: compute the right Schur vectors.

params.name: sort
selctg
params.reference:
`SELCTG` must be declared EXTERNAL in the calling subroutine. If `SORT = 'N'`, `SELCTG` is not referenced. If `SORT = 'S'`, `SELCTG` is used to select eigenvalues to sort to the top left of the Schur form. An eigenvalue `ALPHA(j)`/`BETA(j)` is selected if `SELCTG(ALPHA(j),BETA(j))` is true.

Note that a selected complex eigenvalue may no longer satisfy `SELCTG(ALPHA(j),BETA(j))` = .TRUE. after ordering, since ordering may change the value of complex eigenvalues (especially if the eigenvalue is ill-conditioned), in this case `INFO` is set to N+2 (See `INFO` below).

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A, B, `VSL`, and `VSR`. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the first of the pair of matrices. On exit, A has been overwritten by its generalized Schur form S.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the second of the pair of matrices. On exit, B has been overwritten by its generalized Schur form T.

params.name: sdim
params.reference: If `SORT = 'N'`, `SDIM = 0`. If `SORT = 'S'`, `SDIM` = number of eigenvalues (after sorting) for which `SELCTG` is true.

params.name: BETA
params.reference:
On exit, `ALPHA(j)`/`BETA(j)`, $j=1$,...,N, will be the generalized eigenvalues. `ALPHA(j)`, $j=1$,...,N and `BETA(j)`, $j=1$,...,N are the diagonals of the complex Schur form (A,B) output by ZGGES. The `BETA(j)` will be non-negative real.

Note: the quotients `ALPHA(j)`/`BETA(j)` may easily over- or underflow, and `BETA(j)` may even be zero. Thus, the user should avoid naively computing the ratio $\alpha$/$\beta$. However, `ALPHA` will be always less than and usually comparable with norm(A) in magnitude, and `BETA` always less than and usually comparable with norm(B).

params.name: VSL
params.reference: If `JOBVSL = 'V'`, `VSL` will contain the left Schur vectors. Not referenced if `JOBVSL = 'N'`.

params.name: ldvsl
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix `VSL`. $\mathrm{LDVSL} \ge 1$, and if `JOBVSL = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVSL} \ge N$.

params.name: VSR
params.reference: If `JOBVSR = 'V'`, `VSR` will contain the right Schur vectors. Not referenced if `JOBVSR = 'N'`.

params.name: ldvsr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix `VSR`. $\mathrm{LDVSR} \ge 1$, and if `JOBVSR = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVSR} \ge N$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, N)$. For good performance, `LWORK` must generally be larger.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `=1,...,N`:  The QZ iteration failed.  (A,B) are not in Schur form, but `ALPHA(j)` and `BETA(j)` should be correct for $j=\mathrm{INFO}+1$,...,N.
-   `> N`: =N+1: other than QZ iteration failed in $\mathrm{ZHGEQZ} =N+2$: after reordering, roundoff changed values of some complex eigenvalues so that leading eigenvalues in the Generalized Schur form no longer satisfy `SELCTG`=.TRUE.  This could also be caused due to scaling. =N+3: reordering failed in ZTGSEN.
